events.title: Update 2.4.6: the soundtrack starts on its own
events.summary: A curator wrote yesterday that there was no music in the game, even though the page advertises a soundtrack. He was right.The file was there, but the function that plays it was called from exactly one place: the button in the top bar. At startup that button showed a muted icon, in grey. A player who did not notice it played in silence from start to finish.In 2.4.6 the soundtrack starts at launch. events.title: Update 2.4.5: readability
events.summary: A player reported that the game launched at a microscopic scale on his 4K screen, and that the text was not only tiny but also too low in contrast to read. Both points were correct, and both were measurable.Interface size. The whole layout was written in fixed pixels for a 1600x900 screen. On a 4K display it therefore kept its physical size and used about a fifth of the screen. The game now works out a scale factor at startup from the window size: x2.4 at 3840x2160, x1.6 at 1440p, x1.2 at 1080p.

events.title: Update 2.4.4: the localization is fixed
events.summary: A curator pointed out that parts of the game were still showing in French no matter which language you picked. They were right, and the cause ran deeper than a few forgotten strings.The game was choosing its language too late at startup. On every launch, the news ticker, the career title, the quest list and the portfolio were drawn before the language was applied. They came up in French for everyone, then corrected themselves a few seconds later.What changed in 2.4.4:The language is now selected
